notes: The metric and label names assume Grafana Cloud Prometheus-compatible translation of the OTEL signals emitted by platform-observability and backend-api.
The DB dashboard is symptom-oriented until explicit DB pool metrics are added in a later phase.

dashboards.title: API Golden Signals
dashboards.scope: API request traffic, error ratio, latency, and top routes

dashboards.title: Runtime Path Status
dashboards.scope: Runtime mode and telemetry profile visibility across direct OTLP and collector-gateway paths

dashboards.title: DB Connectivity Symptoms
dashboards.scope: DB-backed route latency, request failures, and postgres-related logs
